summary:
Call "event_" + event_name in the target objects. That function must be public. The target can be a single object or an array of objects.

For a single target, call the event function in that object first, then in every object returned by its all_inventory().

For an array of targets, call the event function in every specified object. Unlike the single-target form, this does not cascade into each object's inventory.

Pass the calling object as the first argument, followed by all supplied arguments.
